verdict.reasons: Core defect: The illustration shows a physical coil of thick, ribbed black hose (commonly used for standard drip lines or tubing) instead of flat drip tape. The article specifically focuses on '20 cm drip tape' (flat, flexible strip), and the visual evidence contradicts the technical description of the product being installed. Additionally, there is a floating, cut segment of flat white/silver tape material lying on the soil which appears disconnected from the coil or the field lines, adding to the visual confusion and implausibility of the installation.

focused_physical_review.reason: A distinct, uninstalled coil of black drip irrigation tape is visible on the ground to the right of the package. A continuous irrigation line runs across the coil and extends toward the background. The line passes very close to the side of the white-and-blue AFP package and the surrounding soil is not uninterrupted as it is occupied by the distinct coil of loose tape.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil
